title: HyperAgent: Planning and Acting over Tool-Schema Hypergraphs for Tool-Use LLM Agents
description:
arXiv:2608.02650v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external tools to complete complex real-world tasks. However, reliable tool-use planning remains challenging due to the limitations of implicit reasoning and the evolving nature of real-world execution environments.
